|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/lieutenantwatts.html</ref>

This guy has more two's than the [[Tonnika Sisters]]! Let's count 'em:

* Power 2 * Ability 2 * Destiny 2 * Deploy 2 * Forfeit 2x2 (or 2+2 or 2 to the power of 2!!) * Adds 2 to combat vehicles * Adds 2 to each weapon destiny on, you guessed it, [[Tempest Scout 2]]!

So the conclusion is obvious! If you can use one Watts in your Dark Side deck, you can probably use two!

Combo: = Power 8, draws two battle destiny, +2 to weapon destiny of vehicle weapon aboard, immune to attrition &lt; 6 and can move as a react. Quite a "chicken" walker!
